# Acquire affected (12.6.68-1 = CUDA 12.6U1) and fixed (12.6.77-1 = CUDA 12.6U2) nvdisasm.

KEYRING=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
cd /work

echo "########## STEP 1: signed index -> Packages ##########"
curl -sS -O $BASE/Packages
echo -n "Packages sha256: "; sha256sum Packages | cut -d' ' -f1
echo "InRelease claims:  cb9beb6ae0a429fa54dc15075083620b9a3172b585c200b72458b1efbb32deac"
gpgv --keyring $KEYRING InRelease >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "gpgv: InRelease GOOD" || echo "gpgv: FAILED"

echo
echo "########## STEP 2: index entries ##########"
for V in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  echo "--- cuda-cuobjdump-12-6 version $V ---"
  awk -v v="$V" '$0=="Package: cuda-cuobjdump-12-6"{p=1;buf=$0"\n";next}
       p&&/^$/{if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\n") printf "%s",buf; p=0; next}
       p{buf=buf$0"\n"}' Packages | grep -E '^(Package|Version|Filename|Size|SHA256):'
done

echo
echo "########## STEP 3: download + verify debs ##########"
mkdir -p debs
for V in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  FN=$(awk -v v="$V" '$0=="Package: cuda-cuobjdump-12-6"{p=1;buf=$0"\n";next}
        p&&/^$/{if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\n") printf "%s",buf; p=0; next}

  EXP=$(awk -v v="$V" '$0=="Package: cuda-cuobjdump-12-6"{p=1;buf=$0"\n";next}
        p&&/^$/{if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\n") printf "%s",buf; p=0; next}
        p{buf=buf$0"\n"}' Packages | awk '/^SHA256:/{print $2}')
  echo "--- $V ---"
  echo "Filename: $FN"
  curl -sS -o debs/$V.deb "$BASE/$FN"
  GOT=$(sha256sum debs/$V.deb | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo "expected sha256: $EXP"
  echo "actual   sha256: $GOT"
  [ "$GOT" = "$EXP" ] && echo "SHA256 MATCH" || echo "SHA256 MISMATCH"
  dpkg-deb -I debs/$V.deb | grep -E 'Package:|Version:' | head -3
done

#!/bin/bash
# Fail-closed acquisition + verification of affected/fixed nvdisasm.
# Chain: InRelease (gpgv vs image cuda-archive-keyring) -> Packages SHA256 -> deb SHA256 -> extract -> --version
set -u
BASE=https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/ubuntu2204/x86_64
KEYRING=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
cd /work
FAIL=0
fail(){ echo "!!! FAIL: $*"; FAIL=1; }

echo "########## STEP 0: tooling ##########"
command -v curl >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null 2>&1; }
command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo "!!! FAIL: no curl"; exit 2; }
echo "curl: $(curl --version | head -1)"

echo
echo "########## STEP 1: authenticated index ##########"
curl -sS -f -O $BASE/InRelease || fail "fetch InRelease"
sha256sum InRelease
if gpgv --keyring $KEYRING InRelease 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gpgv.log; then echo "gpgv: InRelease signature GOOD"; else fail "gpgv InRelease"; fi
grep -q 'Good signature from "cudatools' /tmp/gpgv.log || fail "unexpected signer"

curl -sS -f -O $BASE/Packages || fail "fetch Packages"
CLAIM=$(awk '/^SHA256:/{f=1;next} f&&$3=="Packages"{print $1; exit}' InRelease)
GOT=$(sha256sum Packages | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "InRelease claims Packages sha256: $CLAIM"
echo "downloaded  Packages sha256      : $GOT"
{ [ -n "$CLAIM" ] && [ "$CLAIM" = "$GOT" ]; } && echo "PACKAGES SHA256 MATCH" || fail "Packages hash"

echo
echo "########## STEP 2..3: debs ##########"
mkdir -p debs out
for V in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  echo "=================== cuda-cuobjdump-12-6 $V ==================="
  BLOB=$(awk -v v="$V" '
      $0=="Package: cuda-cuobjdump-12-6"{p=1;buf="";next}
      p&&/^$/{ if(buf ~ ("Version: "v)(/n/?"":"")){} if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\\n") printf "%s", buf; p=0; next }
      p{buf=buf $0 "\n"}
    ' Packages)
  [ -z "$BLOB" ] && { fail "no index entry for $V"; continue; }
  echo "$BLOB" | grep -E '^(Package|Version|Filename|Size|SHA256):'
  FN=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^Filename:/{print $2}')
  EXP=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^SHA256:/{print $2}')
  [ -n "$FN" ] || { fail "no Filename for $V"; continue; }
  [ -n "$EXP" ] || { fail "no SHA256 for $V"; continue; }
  curl -sS -f -o debs/$V.deb "$BASE/$FN" || { fail "download $V"; continue; }
  GOTD=$(sha256sum debs/$V.deb | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo "deb expected: $EXP"
  echo "deb actual  : $GOTD"
  { [ "$EXP" = "$GOTD" ] && [ -n "$GOTD" ]; } && echo "DEB SHA256 MATCH" || { fail "deb hash $V"; continue; }
  ls -l debs/$V.deb
  dpkg-deb -I debs/$V.deb | grep -E '^ (Package|Version)'
  echo "--- payload ---"
  dpkg-deb -c debs/$V.deb | grep -E 'bin/(nvdisasm|cuobjdump)$'
  rm -rf /tmp/x_$V && mkdir -p /tmp/x_$V && dpkg-deb -x debs/$V.deb /tmp/x_$V
  ND=$(find /tmp/x_$V -name nvdisasm -type f | head -1)
  echo "nvdisasm path in package: $ND"
  cp "$ND" out/nvdisasm-$V
  chmod +x out/nvdisasm-$V
  echo "== nvdisasm --version =="
  ./out/nvdisasm-$V --version 2>&1 | head -5
  echo "== sha256 of extracted nvdisasm =="
  sha256sum out/nvdisasm-$V
done

#!/bin/bash
# Acquire the real target: cuda-nvdisasm-12-6 12.6.68-1 (CUDA 12.6U1, affected) vs 12.6.77-1 (CUDA 12.6U2, fixed).
# Verify: InRelease gpgv -> Packages sha256 -> deb sha256 -> dpkg-deb -x -> nvdisasm --version.
set -u
BASE=https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/ubuntu2204/x86_64
KEYRING=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
cd /work
FAIL=0; fail(){ echo "!!! FAIL: $*"; FAIL=1; }
have(){ command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
have curl || { apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null 2>&1; }
have curl || { echo "no curl"; exit 2; }

[ -f InRelease ] || curl -sS -f -O $BASE/InRelease
gpgv --keyring $KEYRING InRelease 2>&1 | tee /tmp/g.log || fail "gpgv"
grep -q 'Good signature from "cudatools' /tmp/g.log || fail "signer"
[ -f Packages ] || curl -sS -f -O $BASE/Packages
CLAIM=$(awk '/^SHA256:/{f=1;next} f&&$3=="Packages"{print $1; exit}' InRelease)
GOT=$(sha256sum Packages | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ -n "$CLAIM" ] && [ "$CLAIM" = "$GOT" ] && echo "PACKAGES SHA256 MATCH ($GOT)" || fail "Packages hash"

echo
for V in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  echo "=========== cuda-nvdisasm-12-6 $V ==========="
  BLOB=$(awk -v v="$V" '$0=="Package: cuda-nvdisasm-12-6"{p=1;buf="";next}
        p&&/^$/{if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\n") printf "%s",buf; p=0; next}
        p{buf=buf $0 "\n"}' Packages)
  [ -z "$BLOB" ] && { fail "no entry $V"; continue; }
  FN=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^Filename:/{print $2}')
  EXP=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^SHA256:/{print $2}')
  curl -sS -f -o "debs/nvdisasm-$V.deb" "$BASE/$FN" || { fail "dl $V"; continue; }
  GOTD=$(sha256sum "debs/nvdisasm-$V.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo "index sha256 : $EXP"
  echo "file  sha256 : $GOTD"
  { [ -n "$EXP" ] && [ "$EXP" = "$GOTD" ]; } && echo "DEB SHA256 MATCH" || { fail "hash $V"; continue; }
  rm -rf /tmp/n$V; mkdir -p /tmp/n$V
  dpkg-deb -x "debs/nvdisasm-$V.deb" /tmp/n$V
  SRC=$(find /tmp/n$V -type f -name nvdisasm | head -1)
  echo "payload: $SRC"
  cp "$SRC" "bin-nvdisasm-$V"; chmod +x "bin-nvdisasm-$V"
  echo "-- nvdisasm --version --"; ./bin-nvdisasm-$V --version 2>&1 | head -3
  echo "-- sha256 --"; sha256sum "bin-nvdisasm-$V"
done

echo
echo "=========== baseline cubin via nvcc (image toolchain) ==========="
mkdir -p in
cat > in/k.cu <<'EOF'
__global__ void addk(float* a, const float* b, int n) {
  int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
  if (i < n) a[i] = a[i] * 2.0f + b[i];
}
extern "C" __global__ void copyk(float* d, const float* s) { d[threadIdx.x] = s[threadIdx.x]; }
EOF
nvcc --version | tail -2
for A in sm_75 sm_52; do
  nvcc -arch=$A -cubin -o in/base_$A.cubin in/k.cu 2>&1 && echo "built in/base_$A.cubin"
done
nvcc -arch=sm_75 -fatbin -o in/base_sm_75.fatbin in/k.cu 2>&1 && echo "built fatbin"
nvcc -arch=sm_75 -c -o in/base_sm_75.o in/k.cu 2>&1 && echo "built relocatable .o"
ls -l in/
sha256sum in/*

echo
echo "=========== baseline disassembly on BOTH builds ==========="
for B in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  for F in in/base_sm_75.cubin in/base_sm_52.cubin in/base_sm_75.fatbin; do
    echo "--- nvdisasm $B on $F ---"
    ./bin-nvdisasm-$B "$F" > /tmp/o.txt 2>/tmp/e.txt; RC=$?
    echo "exit=$RC stdout_bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/o.txt) stderr_bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/e.txt)"
    head -3 /tmp/e.txt
  done
done
echo; echo "ACQ_FAIL=$FAIL"
exit $FAIL

#!/bin/bash
# (A) Test the CWE-416 hypothesis across the whole mutant corpus with valgrind on the AFFECTED build.
# (B) Check whether the second crash (reloc_sym_oob) survives in newer, later releases.
set -u
cd /work
AFF=bin-nvdisasm-12.6.68-1
FIX=bin-nvdisasm-12.6.77-1
BASE=https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/ubuntu2204/x86_64
KEYRING=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg

echo "########## (A) valgrind provenance sweep, affected build ##########"
printf "%-46s %-22s %s\n" "INPUT" "VALGRIND_ERR" "PROVENANCE"
UAF=0
for f in in/plain.cubin in/smem.cubin in/reloc.cubin in/relocobj.o mut/*.bin; do
  out=$(timeout 200 valgrind -q --error-limit=no ./$AFF "$f" 2>&1)
  kind=$(echo "$out" | grep -oE 'Invalid (read|write|free) of size [0-9]+' | head -1)
  prov=$(echo "$out" | grep -oE "(is not stack'd, malloc'd or \(recently\) free'd|Address .* (is|points)|recently free'd|inside a block of size [0-9]+ free'd|freed)" | head -1)
  sig=$(echo "$out" | grep -qE 'SIGSEGV' && echo SIGSEGV || echo no-crash)
  if echo "$out" | grep -qiE "free'd"; then UAF=$((UAF+1)); flag="**UAF**"; else flag=""; fi
  [ -n "$kind$prov" ] && printf "%-46s %-22s %s %s\n" "$(basename $f)" "${kind:-none}" "${prov:-$sig}" "$flag"
done
echo "inputs whose valgrind report mentions freed memory: $UAF"

echo
echo "########## (A2) pristine baseline sanity (same build) ##########"
timeout 200 valgrind -q --error-limit=no ./$AFF in/reloc.cubin 2>&1 | grep -E 'Invalid|ERROR SUMMARY|free' | head -5
echo "[baseline valgrind done]"

echo
echo "########## (B) newer releases: does the reloc_sym_oob crash persist? ##########"
for PV in 12.8.90-1:12-8 13.0.85-1:13-0; do
  VER=${PV%%:*}; MAJ=${PV##*:}
  BLOB=$(awk -v v="$VER" '$0=="Package: cuda-nvdisasm-"'"$MAJ"'"{p=1;buf="";next}
        p&&/^$/{if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\n") printf "%s",buf; p=0; next}
        p{buf=buf $0 "\n"}' Packages)
  [ -z "$BLOB" ] && { echo "no index entry cuda-nvdisasm-$MAJ $VER"; continue; }
  FN=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^Filename:/{print $2}'); EXP=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^SHA256:/{print $2}')
  for V in $VER; do :; done
  OUTF="debs/nvd_$VER.deb"
  [ -f "$OUTF" ] || curl -sS -f -o "$OUTF" "$BASE/$FN"
  GOT=$(sha256sum "$OUTF" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo "--- cuda-nvdisasm-$MAJ $VER : sha256 $([ "$EXP" = "$GOT" ] && echo MATCH || echo MISMATCH) ---"
  rm -rf /tmp/n$VER; mkdir -p /tmp/n$VER; dpkg-deb -x "$OUTF" /tmp/n$VER
  SRC=$(find /tmp/n$VER -type f -name nvdisasm | head -1)
  cp "$SRC" "bin-nvdisasm-$VER"; chmod +x "bin-nvdisasm-$VER"
  ./bin-nvdisasm-$VER --version | tail -1
  for M in mut/reloc.cubin.reloc_sym_oob.bin mut/reloc.cubin.reloc_off_outside.bin; do
    ./bin-nvdisasm-$VER "$M" >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; RC=$?
    echo "   $(basename $M): exit=$RC stderr=$(head -c 120 /tmp/e)"
  done
  sha256sum "bin-nvdisasm-$VER"
done
echo
echo "########## (C) reference: same inputs on 12.6.68 vs 12.6.77 ##########"
for B in $AFF $FIX; do
  echo "--- $B ---"
  for M in mut/reloc.cubin.reloc_sym_oob.bin mut/reloc.cubin.reloc_off_outside.bin; do
    ./$B "$M" >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; RC=$?
    echo "   $(basename $M): exit=$RC stderr=$(head -c 120 /tmp/e)"
  done
done

arguments.impact: Local denial of service: nvdisasm aborts when disassembling a malformed cubin. Because the same bytes still crash the release that NVIDIA shipped as the fix for CVE-2024-0123/-0124/-0125, the "updated version" guidance does not remove this crash. Confidentiality/integrity impact not demonstrated.
arguments.mutation: Baseline built with nvcc 12.8 (-arch=sm_75 -rdc=true -cubin) from a kernel making an indirect device-function-pointer call, then one 64-bit field at the start of a relocation section (.rel.debug_frame / .nv.rel.*, sh_type=9 or .nv.rel) was overwritten: the ELF64 Rela r_info symbol-index field set to 0x0fffffff while keeping the relocation type. Namespace/style bug-for-bug preserved: only bytes changed, file size and all section headers untouched.
arguments.notes: Found while hunting CVE-2024-0124 (CWE-416, use-after-free in nvdisasm on malformed ELF). This is NOT the use-after-free: the sibling mutation reloc_off_outside is the one that CVE-2024-0124's fix addresses (12.6.77 adds 'fatal: Relocaiton offest outside section size'), whereas this one is still unguarded in the same release. Whether it is a distinct vulnerability or a variant of CVE-2024-0123 (CWE-1285 improper input validation) / CVE-2024-0125 (CWE-476 NULL deref) is unresolved - it matches neither CWE-416 nor a NULL dereference; valgrind reports an indexed load from an unmapped address, so CWE-125 is the best current fit. Triage caveat: the affected binary is stripped, so no symbolic stack; the crash is reached before any relocation is applied, i.e. during relocation pre-processing. Not yet tested against 12.8 / 13.0 builds.

stability.notes: Deterministic: 8/8 runs across 4 distinct nvdisasm flag sets (default, --print-code, -ndf, --print-life-ranges) and 3 independent container invocations; never produced a diagnostic message on either build.

Mitigation-demanded control: with r_offset = section_size+1 the affected build does NOT fault (exit 1, 'Code relocators out of bounds for section ...') while the fixed build still emits the new fatal message => the crash requires a large offset, not merely an out-of-range one. (2) Patch localization: fixed build .text +208B, .rodata +192B, new strings 'Relocaiton offest outside section size' and "Could not process EIATTR_INDIRECT_BRANCH_TARGETS for the function '%s'." => the fix is a relocation-offset range check. (3) Mechanism/attribution GAP: valgrind on the faulting run reports 'Invalid read of size 8 ... Address 0x84a99667 is not stack'd, malloc'd or (recently) free'd' plus 'Access not within mapped region' => out-of-bounds read (CWE-125 shape), NOT a use-after-free; faulting insn is an indexed load 'and (%rdx,%rdi,8),%rax' in a stripped binary. So it is definitely the code path that 12.6U2 patched, but I cannot confirm it is the use-after-free the advisory describes; the free-then-use sequence was not observed. ## Advisory facts (tool-verified)
- NVIDIA bulletin a_id/5577 (Oct 2024): nvdisasm, CWE-416 use-after-free, "malformed ELF",
  CVSS 3.1 3.3 Low (AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L), Windows+Linux,
  affected "all versions up to and including CUDA Toolkit 12.6U1", fixed 12.6U2.
  Source: https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5577
- NVD API (services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0?cveId=CVE-2024-0124): CWE-416,
  cpe versionEndExcluding 12.6.2.

## Artifacts acquired (signed chain verified)
Repo https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/ubuntu2204/x86_64
- gpgv InRelease => "Good signature from cudatools <cudatools@nvidia.com>",
  RSA key EB693B3035CD5710E231E123A4B469963BF863CC, gpgv_exit=0.
- InRelease SHA256 of Packages matched download (cb9beb6a...).
- cuda-nvdisasm-12-6 12.6.68-1  sha256 34848a95...05c  (12.6U1, affected)
- cuda-nvdisasm-12-6 12.6.77-1  sha256 c36030ea...cb2  (12.6U2, fixed)
- Extracted nvdisasm: affected 9f146d28...80c (50683864 B, built 2024-08-14, V12.6.68)
                       fixed    534cbe6b...b30 (50683896 B, built 2024-09-12, V12.6.77)
- NOTE: cuda-cuobjdump-12-6 contains ONLY cuobjdump; nvdisasm is cuda-nvdisasm-12-6.

## Result
Differential CONFIRMED on the relocation path; CWE-416 NOT confirmed.

input: mut/reloc.cubin.reloc_off_outside.bin
(baseline nvcc -arch=sm_75 -rdc=true -cubin; one Rela r_offset -> 0x7fffffff)

| build | exit | stderr |
|---|---|---|
| 12.6.68-1 (affected) | 139 SIGSEGV | (none) |
| 12.6.77-1 (fixed)    | 1       | fatal : Relocaiton offest outside section size |

Repeated for 4 flag sets; deterministic.
masked-control (r_offset = size+1): affected exits 1 with
"Code relocators out of bounds for section '.text._Z9indirectkPff'" -> no crash.

valgrind: "Invalid read of size 8 ... Address 0x84a99667 is not stack'd, malloc'd or
(recently) free'd" / "Access not within mapped region" => OOB read, not UAF.
gdb: SIGSEGV at 0x40b6be `and (%rdx,%rdi,8),%rax` (stripped binary, no symbols).

## Independent anomaly (NOT the CVE)
mut/reloc.cubin.reloc_sym_oob.bin (Rela r_info symbol index = 0x0fffffff)
=> SIGSEGV exit 139 on BOTH 12.6.68-1 and 12.6.77-1, i.e. still unfixed in 12.6U2.

## Harness caveat
container_exec supervisor never sets signal_verified (control `kill -SEGV $$` also
returned unverified_signal), so crash confirmation relies on exit 139 +
bash "Segmentation fault (core dumped)" + gdb/valgrind, not on the supervisor.
